releaseNotes:
1. Map Screen Responsive Top App Bar: Restructured header with left hamburger menu button, centered search bar, and right overflow button respecting Android status bar safe-area insets across all screen widths and resolutions.
2. Search Bar Visibility & Usability: Resolved vertical and horizontal clipping with a dedicated 42dp rounded search box, clear button, and real-time search suggestions dropdown. Search bar remains completely visible and usable during map panning and zooming.
3. Left Navigation Drawer Reliability: Standardized 48x48 logical pixel minimum touch target for the hamburger icon with responsive tap handling, smooth edge-swipe drawer opening from the left edge (36dp threshold), and a dedicated close button in the drawer header.
4. Gesture Priority & Conflict Resolution: Resolved touch interception so left-edge swipe opens the drawer without interfering with map one-finger panning, two-finger zooming, or tower marker dragging.
5. Feeder List Expansion & State Preservation: Opening and closing the left or right navigation drawer preserves all expanded feeder sections and scroll offsets with zero state resets.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. Precise Route & Bend Geometry Interpolation: Fault distance calculation strictly follows the transmission line's cumulative route geometry and intermediate polyline bends between towers, ensuring the estimated fault marker is placed directly ON the actual feeder line.
2. Proportional Span Traversal: Calculates exact proportional distances between consecutive towers based on relay distance readings without radial circles or straight chords.
3. Compass Unobscured & UI Layout Fix: Repositioned Estimated Fault Information Bar below compass button and GIS tools row, guaranteeing the compass is 100% visible, accessible, and functional.
4. Collapsible & Dismissible Fault Bar: Added expand/collapse toggle for compact and full views, quick 'Locate on Map' camera centering, and reopenable floating pill.
5. Rich High-Contrast Fault Marker: Displays previous tower, next tower, distances (+/- km), and cumulative relay distance with a high-contrast badge and pulsing lightning indicator across all 5 map layers.
